stem: A supervisor verbally asks the technician to blend held material into the normal lot, but the controlled hold instruction remains active. What is the safest process?
choices: Follow the supervisor's verbal request because direct supervision overrides the written hold.
Keep the hold active and resolve the instruction conflict through the authorized release/control process before moving or blending the material.
Remove the hold record first so the verbal request and material status no longer conflict.
Blend only part of the held material as a compromise while the rest remains isolated.
rationale: An active hold remains in force until it is resolved through the controlled process. A verbal instruction does not automatically create release authority or erase the recorded status. Technician I should preserve the hold and escalate the conflict so the authorized role can formally change disposition if appropriate.
